Name: Chocolate Rabbits
Author: FablePH
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
Tired of the same old vanilla rabbits? Mix it up a bit and turn those dull rabbits into Chocolate Bunnies! Just drop the folders into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder!

There are two files you can choose from. The main file has the Chocolate Rabbits, babies and all! The second file has an edit of the vanilla rabbit sprite that includes the bow I added onto my Chocolate Rabbits, if that suits your fancy!

Hope you enjoy!
